# Performance

This page gives the newest measurements that are committed in
`benchmark/results/`. The report is "zr bench, the median of 5 run(s) at 86ef4c5a4, 2026-10-17 07:05 UTC". Read the
numbers of one machine against each other only.
[How to measure performance](../how-to/measure-performance.md)
tells how to make them again.

## Run time

Each program in `benchmark/` is built with zr, then run beside
`ruby` and `ruby --yjit` (the ruby that zr pins). The harness checks each
program's output against ruby's recording before it keeps a
time. A ratio under 1 means zr's binary is faster.

| | zr / ruby | zr / yjit |
|---|---|---|
| Geometric mean, 62 programs | 0.38x | 0.83x |
| Start of an empty program (`bm_startup`) | 11 ms against 23 ms | 11 ms against 23 ms |

The 9 programs that ruby runs in less than
2.0 times its own start are not in the mean,
because their time is mostly the start of the process:
`bm_bigint_fib`, `bm_bigint_to_s`, `bm_binary_trees`, `bm_fasta`, `bm_jekyll_lite`, `bm_mandel_term`, `bm_micro_lisp`, `bm_poly_cells`, `bm_sinatra_mini`.

The binary of `bm_startup` is 39 MB: each binary carries the whole
runtime, and a program that calls `eval` also carries the compiler.

### Known slow paths

- **Bignum division on large numbers** (`bm_pidigits`): a
  bignum is an Array of 30-bit limbs in the runtime's Ruby
  (lib/zr/runtime/core/bignum.rb). Products of long numbers use
  Karatsuba's method, but division is the schoolbook method;
  ruby divides with GMP or Karatsuba-class methods in C.
- **Regexp** (`bm_regexp_scan`): the engine is a port of Onigmo
  in Ruby, which the runtime compiles; ruby runs Onigmo's C.
- **Small recursive methods** (`bm_ackermann`, `bm_tree_walker`):
  zr is faster than ruby here, but slower than YJIT.

## Build time

What a build costs, in seconds, with the runtime already built
and cached, with the compiler under ruby.
The report is "zr compile cost, the median of 3 run(s) at 9133a6bf, runtime warm, 2026-09-24 23:50 UTC".

| hir built | 1.750 | 0.006 | 0.058 | 0.289 |

| program object written and linked | 2.473 | 0.085 | 0.359 | 0.407 |
